final: WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(CASE WHEN g <> 0 THEN w * 1.0 / g END) AS avg_wr, COUNT(*) AS n FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wr) AS mean_wr FROM t) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_wr, t.n AS record_count, t.avg_wr - m.mean_wr AS diff FROM t, m ORDER BY (t.avg_wr - m.mean_wr) IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
